name: dataguard-vscode
description: Detect database contract drift between .NET code, stored procedures, and SQL before it reaches production.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: DataGuard runs a local validation CLI and only executes in trusted workspaces.

virtualWorkspaces.description: DataGuard requires a local workspace and CLI executable.

commands.title: DataGuard: Verify SQL Shapes Against Database

dataguard.configPath.description: Path to the DataGuard configuration file, relative to the workspace root.

dataguard.provider.description: Database provider used by explicit DataGuard commands.

dataguard.cliPath.description: Path or command name for the DataGuard CLI. Configure only in User Settings.

dataguard.timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum validation duration before DataGuard terminates its process tree.

dataguard.assessmentTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum local assessment duration. Remote advisory lookup is never enabled by the extension.

scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run test:typescript && node --test out/security.test.js out/run-coordinator.test.js out/command-args.test.js out/ide-safe-contract.test.js out/live-database-confirmation.test.js out/ui/design-tokens.test.js out/ui/dashboard-view.test.js out/ui/redaction.test.js out/ui/redaction-redteam.test.js out/ui/csp-security.test.js out/ui/sql-queries-tree.test.js out/ui/performance-smoke.test.js out/ui/codelens-provider.test.js out/ui/decoration-manager.test.js out/ui/hover-provider.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run compile && npm run test:typescript && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process'),NL=String.fromCharCode(10),CR=String.fromCharCode(13),BS=String.fromCharCode(92),PIPE=String.fromCharCode(124),LT=String.fromCharCode(60),GT=String.fromCharCode(62),Q=String.fromCharCode(34),AMP=String.fromCharCode(38);fs.mkdirSync('coverage',{recursive:true});const files=['out/security.test.js','out/run-coordinator.test.js','out/command-args.test.js','out/ide-safe-contract.test.js','out/live-database-confirmation.test.js','out/ui/design-tokens.test.js','out/ui/dashboard-view.test.js','out/ui/redaction.test.js','out/ui/redaction-redteam.test.js','out/ui/csp-security.test.js','out/ui/sql-queries-tree.test.js','out/ui/performance-smoke.test.js','out/ui/codelens-provider.test.js','out/ui/decoration-manager.test.js','out/ui/hover-provider.test.js'];function mapSrc(raw){let p=raw.trim().split(BS).join('/');if(p.indexOf('out/')===0)p='src/'+p.slice(4);if(p.slice(-3)==='.js')p=p.slice(0,-3)+'.ts';return p;}const major=parseInt(process.versions.node.split('.')[0],10);if(Math.max(major,20)===major){const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--enable-source-maps','--test','--experimental-test-coverage','--test-reporter=spec','--test-reporter-destination=stdout','--test-reporter=lcov','--test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info','--test-reporter=junit','--test-reporter-destination=coverage/junit.xml'].concat(files),{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.status!==0)process.exit(r.status?r.status:1);}else{const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--enable-source-maps','--test','--experimental-test-coverage'].concat(files),{encoding:'utf8'});process.stdout.write(r.stdout?r.stdout:'');process.stderr.write(r.stderr?r.stderr:'');if(r.status!==0)process.exit(r.status?r.status:1);const out=(r.stdout?r.stdout:'').split(CR).join('');const lines=out.split(NL);const cases=[];let fails=0,cur=null;lines.forEach(function(l){const ok=l.indexOf('ok ')===0,nok=l.indexOf('not ok ')===0;if(ok||nok){const d=l.indexOf(' - ');if(d>0){if(cur)cases.push(cur);const name=l.slice(d+3).trim().split(AMP).join('').split(LT).join('').split(GT).join('').split(Q).join('');if(nok)fails++;cur={name:name,nok:nok,sec:'0.0000'};}}else if(cur&&l.trim().indexOf('duration_ms:')===0){const ms=parseFloat(l.trim().slice(12).trim());if(!isNaN(ms))cur.sec=(ms/1000).toFixed(4);}});if(cur)cases.push(cur);const xmlCases=cases.map(function(c){const open=LT+'testcase classname='+Q+'DataGuard.VSCode'+Q+' name='+Q+c.name+Q+' time='+Q+c.sec+Q;return c.nok?open+GT+LT+'failure message='+Q+c.name+Q+'/'+GT+LT+'/testcase'+GT:open+'/'+GT;}).join('');fs.writeFileSync('coverage/junit.xml',LT+'?xml version='+Q+'1.0'+Q+' encoding='+Q+'utf-8'+Q+'?'+GT+LT+'testsuites tests='+Q+cases.length+Q+' failures='+Q+fails+Q+GT+LT+'testsuite name='+Q+'DataGuard.VSCode'+Q+' tests='+Q+cases.length+Q+' failures='+Q+fails+Q+GT+xmlCases+LT+'/testsuite'+GT+LT+'/testsuites'+GT+NL);const recs=[];lines.forEach(function(l){if(l.indexOf('# out')===0&&l.indexOf(PIPE)>0){const cols=l.slice(2).split(PIPE).map(function(s){return s.trim();});const outRel=cols[0].split(BS).join('/');const srcRel=mapSrc(outRel);const diskPath=fs.existsSync(outRel)?outRel:srcRel;const srcLines=fs.existsSync(diskPath)?fs.readFileSync(diskPath,'utf8').split(CR).join('').split(NL):[];const uncov=new Set();if(cols[4]){cols[4].split(',').forEach(function(tok){const n=parseInt(tok.trim(),10);if(n>0)uncov.add(n);});}const da=[];let hit=0,lf=0;for(let i=0;i<srcLines.length;i++){const ln=i+1,txt=srcLines[i].trim();if(!txt||txt.indexOf('//')===0)continue;lf++;const h=uncov.has(ln)?0:1;if(h)hit++;da.push('DA:'+ln+','+h);}recs.push(['TN:','SF:src/DataGuard.VSCode/'+srcRel].concat(da,['LF:'+lf,'LH:'+hit,'end_of_record']).join(NL));}});fs.writeFileSync('coverage/lcov.info',recs.join(NL)+NL);}if(fs.existsSync('coverage/lcov.info')){const norm=fs.readFileSync('coverage/lcov.info','utf8').split(CR).join('').split(NL).map(function(l){if(l.indexOf('SF:')!==0)return l;let p=mapSrc(l.slice(3));if(p.indexOf('src/DataGuard.VSCode/')!==0&&p.indexOf('/')!==0)p='src/DataGuard.VSCode/'+p;return 'SF:'+p;});fs.writeFileSync('coverage/lcov.info',norm.join(NL));}"
